status_reviews.researcher_notes: Sheet shows Status=operating with LastUpdated=2025-09-25. However, EIA Aug 2026 (most recent independent data) shows Status=Construction. Enbridge website confirms construction began Sep 2024 with Aug 2025 in-service target. That target has passed (now Sep 2026) but project still in construction per EIA. No independent evidence of in-service completion found. Recommend status change to 'construction' with no StartYear1 until project actually reaches in-service.

summary: P7809: System Alignment Project is a TN-VA-NC FERC transmission upgrade by Enbridge (operating as East Tennessee Natural Gas Co, NOT 'Tennessee Gas Pipeline Co LLC'). Major findings: (1) Status is construction, not operating, per EIA Aug 2026 despite Aug 2025 target; (2) Endpoints incorrect (full span TN→VA→NC); (3) Operator field is wrong company name; (4) All 11 HAS_REF units cited EIA data.php (nav page, not source) - re-verified with actual EIA releases; (5) Capacity 0.0 correct (realignment, no new capacity); (6) Minor length discrepancy (23.0 vs 22.5 mi, within rounding). Concerns: Status/StartYear validity (sheet says operating/2025, independent sources say construction/delayed).
